TaskDescription: Fast periodic visual stimulation: natural images of non-face objects at 6 Hz with a face image every 5th item (1.2 Hz); each sequence starts with 4 object images before the first face [O O O O F O O O O F ...]. Sequences of 70 s (release table) cut from 2 s before onset to 2 s after the end and merged per participant (README). Participants: first trigger present, xstart -2 s.

Letswave5.Description: Minimal preprocessing: Micromed TRC imported in Letswave 5, segmented into sequences and merged; no filtering stated (README).
